It was published as part of [[Phase III: Trials of the Jedi|Phase III]] of the multimedia project on [[June 11]], [[2024]]. The novel is a major story in the overall High Republic saga while also focusing on the relationship between [[Jedi Master]]s [[Avar Kriss]] and [[Elzar Mann]],{{Twitter|DarthInternous|status/1796584347790868953|[[Tom Hoeler]]|quote=Nope, its the next big High Republic story, of which Avar/Elzar play a key role. In the same way that Empire is "about Leia and Han's relationship" that movie is still largely about moving Star War's overall story forward. If that helps as a comparison.}} {{C|In response to: "I don’t think I realized until now that this book actually deals with the overall story, I assumed it was just about Avar and Elzar's history and relationship."}} who must confront their true desires amid the ongoing [[Nihil conflict]].
